title: testOS Run Manifest
description: Top-level manifest written by the testOS runner to the USB results directory. Extends the original schema_version=1 manifest with a required provenance block that cryptographically binds the run to the run-intent, plan, benchmark catalog, testOS image, source commit, and run_id. The strict evidence validator (tools/validate-testos-evidence.py) re-checks every provenance field. Schema version remains 1; the provenance block is required for physical runs and is rejected if it contains placeholder values.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the run started.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the run finished (or was aborted). Must be >= started_at.

mode.description: 'all' | 'selection:<comma-separated-ids>' | 'aborted'. Must NOT be 'dry-run' for a physical run.

attempted.description: The ids of benchmarks that were attempted (regardless of pass/fail).

passed.description: The ids of benchmarks that passed.

failed.description: The ids of benchmarks that failed.

skipped.description: The ids of benchmarks that were skipped.

host.description: Host fingerprint (same as in each BenchResult; denormalized for convenience).

testos_version.description: testOS image version (from /etc/testos/version). Must match provenance.testos_version from the run intent.

run_id.description: Run identifier copied from the run intent. Must match the host checkpoint.

source_commit.description: 40-character git commit SHA copied from the run intent. Recorded in evidence, not merely printed.

source_version.description: Rush Linux version copied from the run intent. Must match the VERSION file.

testos_version.description: testOS image version copied from the run intent. Must match the top-level testos_version and the running image.

testos_image_digest.description: SHA-256 of the testOS image bytes, copied from the run intent.

plan_sha256.description: SHA-256 of plan.json bytes, copied from the run intent. The validator re-hashes the plan file bundled with the results.

benchmark_catalog_sha256.description: SHA-256 of bench-list.toml bytes, copied from the run intent. The validator re-hashes the catalog bundled with the image.

intent_generated_at.description: generated_at copied from the run intent. The validator checks freshness against the run's started_at.

intent_dry_run.description: dry_run copied from the run intent. Must be false for a physical run.

checkpoint_nonce.description: Checkpoint nonce / campaign identity copied from the run intent. The resume step confirms it matches the host checkpoint.

intent_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the run-intent.json bytes the runner read from the USB. Binds the manifest to the exact intent file.

testos_image_commit.description: REQUIRED (corrective-2 F4): the full 40-char git commit SHA the testOS image was built from. SEPARATE from source_commit (the host-workflow commit). Copied from the run intent's testos_image_commit and cross-checked by the runner against /etc/testos/source-sha. The validator verifies it exists in git and matches the intent's value.

campaign_id.description: Optional campaign identity copied from the run intent.
